---
title: "Demo 3 - Wind Mechanisms"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    social: []
    source_code: embed
params:
  data_file: "beijing_air_processed.csv"
  season_year: "All"
  season: "All"
  region: NULL
  station: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(plotly)

wd_levels_full <- c("N","NNE","NE","ENE","E","ESE","SE","SSE","S","SSW","SW","WSW","W","WNW","NW","NNW","CV")
aqi_palette <- c("darkgreen", "gold", "orange", "red", "purple", "brown")
wd_full_names <- c(
  N = "North", NNE = "North-Northeast", NE = "Northeast", ENE = "East-Northeast",
  E = "East", ESE = "East-Southeast", SE = "Southeast", SSE = "South-Southeast",
  S = "South", SSW = "South-Southwest", SW = "Southwest", WSW = "West-Southwest",
  W = "West", WNW = "West-Northwest", NW = "Northwest", NNW = "North-Northwest"
)
```

```{r data}
data_file <- params$data_file
stopifnot(file.exists(data_file))

air_raw <- readr::read_csv(data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

region_levels <- sort(unique(air_raw$region))
station_levels <- sort(unique(air_raw$station))

region_param <- if (is.null(params$region)) region_levels else params$region
station_param <- if (is.null(params$station)) station_levels else params$station

filtered <- air_raw %>%
  mutate(
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")),
    region = factor(region, levels = region_levels),
    wd = factor(wd, levels = wd_levels_full),
    date = as_date(datetime)
  ) %>%
  { if (!identical(params$season_year, "All")) filter(., season_year == params$season_year) else . } %>%
  { if (!identical(params$season, "All")) filter(., season == params$season) else . } %>%
  filter(region %in% region_param, station %in% station_param)
```

# Wind patterns

## Column {data-width="55"}

### Pollution rose (all periods)

```{r}
df_rose_all <- filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(wd), wd != "CV", !is.na(aqi_level)) %>%
  mutate(wd_full = factor(wd, levels = wd_levels_full)) %>%
  count(wd_full, aqi_level, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(wd_full) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(df_rose_all) == 0) {
  ggplot() + theme_void()
} else {
  ggplot(df_rose_all, aes(x = wd_full, y = freq, fill = aqi_level)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "gray25") +
    coord_polar(start = -pi/16) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = aqi_palette, name = "AQI level") +
    labs(
      title = "Pollution rose (all periods)",
      subtitle = "Frequency share within direction",
      x = "Wind direction",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

### Winter vs Summer comparison

```{r}
df_rose_ws <- filtered %>%
  filter(season %in% c("Winter", "Summer")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wd), wd != "CV", !is.na(aqi_level)) %>%
  mutate(wd_full = factor(wd, levels = wd_levels_full)) %>%
  count(season, wd_full, aqi_level, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(season, wd_full) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(df_rose_ws) == 0) {
  ggplot() + theme_void()
} else {
  ggplot(df_rose_ws, aes(x = wd_full, y = freq, fill = aqi_level)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "gray25") +
    coord_polar(start = -pi/16) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = aqi_palette, name = "AQI level") +
    labs(
      title = "Winter vs Summer: Pollution rose",
      subtitle = "Frequency share within direction",
      x = "Wind direction",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~season, ncol = 2) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## Column {data-width="45"}

### Mean PM2.5 by wind direction (fill = wind speed)

```{r}
df_pm_dir <- filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(wd), wd != "CV", !is.na(pm2_5), !is.na(wspm)) %>%
  mutate(wd_full = factor(wd, levels = wd_levels_full)) %>%
  group_by(wd_full) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_pm25 = mean(pm2_5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_wspm = mean(wspm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_full = factor(recode(wd_full, !!!wd_full_names), levels = wd_full_names[wd_levels_full[wd_levels_full != "CV"]])
  )

if (nrow(df_pm_dir) == 0) {
  ggplot() + theme_void()
} else {
  p_dir <- ggplot(df_pm_dir, aes(
    x = dir_full,
    y = mean_pm25,
    fill = mean_wspm,
    text = paste0(
      "Direction: ", dir_full, "<br>",
      "Mean PM2.5: ", round(mean_pm25, 1), " µg/m³<br>",
      "Mean wind speed: ", round(mean_wspm, 2), " m/s"
    )
  )) +
    geom_col(color = "gray25") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Wind speed (avg)") +
    labs(
      title = "Mean PM2.5 by wind direction",
      subtitle = "Fill = mean wind speed (m/s)",
      x = "Wind direction",
      y = "Mean PM2.5 (ug/m^3)"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  ggplotly(p_dir, tooltip = "text")
}
```
